description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DSH with parallel projects across hosts, file browsing and editing, recursive search, terminals, Git diffs, and Agent tools to edit, build and test remotely. Optional IDE layout.
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 远程工作区：多主机项目并行、文件浏览与编辑、递归搜索、终端、Git 差异，以及 Agent 远程编辑、构建与测试；可选 IDE 布局。
